user.title: Generate a Shelly connection
user.description: No relay, Docker, VPS, port mapping, or manual token is required. Press Submit to generate a private outbound WebSocket address for this Home Assistant instance.

generated.title: Your Shelly WebSocket address
generated.description:
Copy this exact address:

`{shelly_url}`

Then press Submit to finish adding the integration. In the Shelly web UI, open Settings → Connectivity → Outbound WebSocket, enable it, paste the address as the server URL, save, and connect.

error.no_url: Home Assistant could not determine a reachable URL. Configure an Internal or External URL in Home Assistant network settings and try again.

abort.already_configured: Shelly RPC Bridge is already configured.
